claims.object_text: mRNA expression marker in preterm hippocampus
claims.quote: mRNA expression of oligodendrocyte lineage cells (CSPG4, MBP), neuronal growth (INA, VEGFA), and the GABAergic/glutamatergic system (SLC32A1, SLC1A2, GRIN1, GRIN2C, DLG4).

claims.object_text: ganaxolone did not affect mRNA deficits
claims.quote: These deficits were not affected by ganaxolone at the doses used at the equivalent of normal term.
